embed.name: embed
embed.input: RNA sequences from command line (--sequences) or sequence file (--sequences_file) in FASTA/FA format or text format
embed.output: RNA sequence embeddings in NumPy array format (.npy file)
embed.description: Generates numerical embeddings (vectors) for RNA sequences using pre-trained RNA-FM models. Converts RNA sequences into fixed-length numerical representations for downstream analysis tasks. No training required - uses pre-trained models directly.

predict_ss.name: predict_ss
predict_ss.input: RNA sequences from command line (--sequences) or sequence file (--sequences_file) in FASTA/FA format or text format
predict_ss.output: Secondary structure predictions in multiple formats: probability matrices (.npy), structure plots (.png), and structure files (.ct). Supports intelligent output mode where directory paths automatically generate all formats using sequence IDs as filenames
predict_ss.description: Predicts RNA secondary structure probability maps using pre-trained models. Generates pairing probability matrices and visualizations. Supports intelligent output mode for automatic file generation. No training required - uses pre-trained models directly.

cluster.name: cluster
cluster.input: Folder containing RF*.fasta files, where each FASTA file represents an RNA family
cluster.output: t-SNE clustering visualization plot in image format (.png, .jpg, .pdf, etc.) showing RNA family distributions
cluster.description: Performs RNA family clustering analysis using t-SNE dimensionality reduction. Visualizes the distribution of different RNA families in embedding space. Uses pre-trained models to generate embeddings, then applies t-SNE for visualization. No training required - uses pre-trained models directly.

classify.name: classify
classify.input: Folder containing RF*.fasta files, where each FASTA file represents an RNA family for training
classify.output: Trained RNA family classifier model (.pt checkpoint file) and optional training history plots (loss_history.png, accuracy_history.png)
classify.description: Trains a classifier to categorize RNA sequences into different RNA families. Uses pre-trained embeddings as features and trains a simple classifier (linear layer) on top. Requires training step - training time depends on data size. Recommended to use GPU for faster training.

predict_expression.name: predict_expression
predict_expression.input: CSV file containing mRNA sequences and expression values (Sequence, Value columns, optional splits column)
predict_expression.output: Trained mRNA expression level prediction model (.pt checkpoint file) and optional training history plots (loss_history.png, accuracy_history.png)
predict_expression.description: Trains a binary classifier to predict mRNA expression levels (high/low expression). Uses pre-trained embeddings as features and trains a classifier on top. Requires training step - training time depends on data size. Recommended to use GPU for faster training.
